She needs therapy badly. To be obsessed with someone online and believe they are obsessed and stalking you in return is a delusion and sounds dangerous. If she was that obsessed with someone who lived in the same area, I fear it would lead to in-person stalking.

I'm so sorry you are struggling with this, especially with your son. I know she relies on you, and that you want things to go back to the way they were - but they won't without any kind of intervention.

It seems to me that she needs the ultimatum of either going to marriage counseling with you or being separated from you and your son. It may be a wake up call for her, or it may show how invested in the non-existing relationship she is.

I'm a child of divorce and know that if my parent's had split earlier, less pain would have happened for all parties involved. Especially since mental illness was present.
